summary: Postmark is a REST/JSON email delivery API for transactional and bulk email. It covers sending (single, batch, template), bounces, message search, servers, domains, sender signatures, stats, suppressions, inbound processing and webhooks.

value.description: Server Token for server-level requests (send email, bounces, etc.). Each reference page states which token to use.
Account Token for account-level endpoints (servers, domains, sender signatures, etc.).

keyParams.name: From
keyParams.description: Sender address; needs a confirmed Sender Signature

value.purpose: Send up to 500 messages per call

sources.quote: the batch endpoint accepts up to 500 messages per API call, and up to 50 MB payload size

endpoints.reasoning: Downgraded from documented: quote not found on https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api.

value.description: Bounce search uses count (max 500) and offset; count+offset cannot exceed 10,000, so use fromdate/todate to retrieve more. Other endpoints were not checked.

value.signatureVerification: No HMAC signing. Protect with HTTP Basic auth in the URL and IP allowlisting.
value.description: Postmark POSTs JSON to your URL on events. Endpoints are verified on create/edit and must return 200. Non-2xx responses are retried. Event types that keep failing are paused.

sources.quote: Postmark does not currently support HMAC webhook signature verification.

value.description: JSON body with numeric ErrorCode and Message. The code is also echoed in the X-PM-ApiErrorCode header. Most input errors are HTTP 422; auth failures are 401. Batch sends return per-message codes inside a 200.

sources.quote: it returns a JSON body with a numeric ErrorCode and a human-readable Message

risks.title: No webhook signatures
risks.detail: Webhooks are not signed. You must rely on Basic auth in the URL, IP allowlisting and payload validation.

risks.title: Rate limits undocumented
risks.detail: The docs mention 429 but give no numeric limits or rate-limit headers on the pages read.

risks.title: No versioning policy found
risks.detail: The URLs have no version and no versioning or changelog policy was found.

risks.title: Two token types
risks.detail: Server and account tokens apply to different endpoints. Using the wrong one returns 401 (error code 10).

risks.title: Batch partial failures
risks.detail: Batch sends return HTTP 200 with per-message error codes, so you must inspect each result.

risks.title: Offset pagination cap
risks.detail: Bounce search is capped at 10,000 results and its date filters use Eastern Time.

risks.title: Sender and approval restrictions
risks.detail: Sending needs a confirmed Sender Signature, and new accounts are restricted until approved. The Bulk API requires approval.

risks.title: Incomplete page coverage
risks.detail: Fetched pages were truncated and only 5 pages were allowed, so most endpoints were not read.

risks.title: Unverified claim: endpoints[3] GET /bounces
risks.detail: The agent marked this as documented, but quote not found on https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api. Treat it as inferred and confirm with the provider.

openQuestions: What are the numeric rate limits per token or server, and are rate-limit headers returned?
